root_idea.summary: The root centers on something being propelled, emitted, or spread outward.
root_idea.development: This outward movement develops into the spreading of scent, the blowing of wind, the ejection of blood or milk, forceful propulsion, striking, and the bestowal of gifts or benefits.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun is presented under its normalized citation form نَفْحَة.

senses.definition: A sudden blast or portion of punishment; a single infliction.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction نَفْحَةٌ مِنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ, it denotes a sudden visitation or blast of divine punishment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To diffuse an odour; of perfume, to spread its fragrance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of perfume or another scented substance whose odour spreads.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of wind, to blow or waft upon something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The blowing may be gentle or cool; the verb can also describe the wind beginning to stir.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eject or spurt forth blood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a vein or a stab wound that sends out blood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To churn milk once.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A single act of churning is expressed by the construction نَفَحَ اللَّبَنَ نَفْحَةً.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike or hit, especially lightly with a sword by a side-blow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With a sword, the action may involve reaching or hitting something from a distance; the verb also has the broader sense ‘to smite or beat’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To throw or cast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general transitive use describing the act of casting something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To thrust, push, or repel something away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is moved away from the agent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse or similar animal, to kick with a hind leg or hoof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The action is distinguished from رَمْحٌ, which is described as striking with both hind legs together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give something; to bestow a gift or favour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a person as recipient and a thing, gift, or favour as what is bestowed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend with or encounter an opponent face-to-face in combat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The conventional image is of opposing parties coming so close in battle that each can reach the other’s breath, with neither shields nor another barrier before the face.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend on behalf of someone; to defend or repel attack from him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَنْ to express defence or repulsion on another’s behalf.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An odour, whether pleasant or foul; also a plentiful odour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can describe a good or bad smell and is used in expressions such as نَفْحَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ and نَفْحَةٌ خَبِيثَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A blast or breath of wind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The blast may be pleasant and fragrant, or hot and grievous, depending on the wind described.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first gush of blood from a wound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use for the initial emission of blood after wounding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single churning of milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal expression for one act of churning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gift, favour, or act of kindness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural نَفَحَات can denote recurring benefactions or favours and can be used metaphorically of breaths of mercy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wind that blows forcefully and raises dust; also a cool-blowing south wind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective describes the force or character of the wind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An animal that kicks with a hind leg or the extremity of its hoof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of a horse or similar animal liable to kick in this manner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel whose milk flows without being drawn; also an udder that does not retain its milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The animal or udder is characterized by milk issuing freely without milking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow that sends an arrow far or propels it with force.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is used of the bow’s powerful or far-reaching propulsion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A branch of the nabʿ tree from which a bow is made.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized designation associated with the material used for such a bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Diffusing much odour or fragrance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of musk or another substance that spreads a strong scent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a stab, ejecting blood abundantly or quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive adjective for a wound whose blood issues forcefully or rapidly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who gives many gifts or benefits.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person characterized by abundant generosity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bestower of many benefits; an epithet applied to God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The epithet is reported as a lexical usage, though some authorities disapproved of it because it was not applied in the Quran or traditions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Diffusing odour; fragrant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of a fragrant object or substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rennet or the rennet-bag of a young ruminant, used to thicken milk into cheese.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term refers to the substance or stomach portion of a suckling kid or lamb before it begins eating; related forms include أَنْفِحَة and بِنْفَحَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of tree resembling the eggplant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate botanical use of the noun.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Striking with a sword by a side-blow.
Animal kicking with a hind leg or hoof.
Pleasant fragrant or hot grievous wind.
Quran-attested blast or portion of punishment.
First gush of blood from a wound.
Recurring acts of kindness or favours.
Powerful bow and the nabʿ branch used to make it.
Divine epithet for the bestower of benefits.

cautions: The sole Quran occurrence is in the construction نَفْحَةٌ مِنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ; the broader odour, wind, gift, and other branches are Classical Arabic meanings rather than additional Quranic occurrences.
